entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Tab and Shell.Current.GoToAsync navigation bug #31136
  • "dotnet workload install maui" fails with "Version 26.0.9251-xcode26.0 of package "microsoft.ios.sdk.net9.0_26.0.msi.x64 not found #31135
  • iOS Randomly crash in release mode, debug mode can not be reproduced #31132
  • [NET10] Make `IPlatformMeasureInvalidationController` public #31131
    .NET 10.0-rc1
  • IndicatorTemplate in IndicatorView does not update when set dynamically without initial value #31128
  • I8_Headers_and_Footers - Repeatedly toggling keyboard open would cause a space above the name textbox and faction picker. #31127
  • [MacCatalyst] Setting NULL for the DatePicker then the picker should default to Todays date when it's opened #31124
  • [iOS, Mac] TabbedPage FlowDirection Property Renders Opposite Layout Direction When Set via ViewModel Binding #31121

Closed

  • Android 7.1, with FlyoutIsPresented = true , can't expand the shell #15081
  • EmbedAssembliesIntoApk no longer works in .NET 9 #31072
  • Big design issue when upgrading from .NET MAUI 10 Preview 5 to Preview 6 #31110
  • [Android] "PlatformView cannot be null here" crash when switching shell tabs #22996
  • Task and Project controls are not accessible with keyboard:A11y_.NET maui_User can create a new task_Keyboard #30891
    .NET 10.0-rc2
  • Voice over is not announcing role as combo box and state as collapsed for "Project" combobox:A11y_.NET maui_user can creat a tak_Screen reader #30899
    .NET 10.0-rc2
  • Space entered by user is not visible in Entry Control of MAUI if Space character is last character #1 #31017
  • [Android] Inconsistent footer scrolling in CollectionView when EmptyView as string #28765
    .NET 9 SR8
